note: evidence_class on a claim's manifest must be exactly 'E6' — the class_id above. slug and spec.slug below are cosmetic (used only in this page's own URL and the site's navigation) and are never valid values for evidence_class.

manifest_fields.name: attestation
manifest_fields.why: a non-empty object — what they are attesting to

manifest_fields.name: attestor_domain
manifest_fields.why: the domain that signed the reply, e.g. charity.org

manifest_fields.name: message_raw
manifest_fields.why: the reply exactly as it arrived, headers and body, DKIM-Signature intact

spec.name: Counterparty Attestation
spec.verifier_does: verifies a signature from the party who benefited — their own key, or their mail server's
